strategy_notes: Legal moves are more important than risky moves.
When using wild cards, prefer colors that occur often in own hand.
If opponent has few cards, blocking and draw cards become more valuable.
In two-player UNO, reverse behaves like skip and can immediately deny the opponent a turn.
Use skip, reverse, draw_two, and wild_draw_four aggressively when the opponent is close to winning.
Save wild cards for winning, escaping bad colors, or blocking a nearly finished opponent.
When choosing a wild color, choose the color that appears most often in your remaining hand.
Prefer a playable number card that leaves you with more cards of the same color for future turns.
Declare UNO whenever playing down to one card if the server supports it.
Never risk an illegal wild_draw_four if the game context says the move is not playable.
